title: Final Answer (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the heat capacity c_v in part (a).

title: Final Answer (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the heat capacity c in part (b).

title: Mean Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the mean energy per atom as bar(epsilon) = Delta tanh(Delta/kT).

title: Heat Capacity Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct differentiation of mean energy to find the specific heat c_v.

title: Limit Behavior Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student should analyze the behavior of c_i when kT << Delta_i correctly.

title: Integration Setup
description: Optional Criteria: The student should set up the integral for the specific heat correctly in part (b).

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the expressions for energy levels.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that no factors are omitted in the final expressions for heat capacity.
